title: The Work of the Holy Spirit, Sorrow Will Turn to Joy

questions.question: Jesus warned the disciples that people will put them out of synagogues. Indeed, the hour is coming when whoever kills you will think he is doing what?
questions.explanation: John 16:2 (ESV): "They will put you out of the synagogues. Indeed, the hour is coming when whoever kills you will think he is offering service to God."

questions.question: Jesus told them "I did not say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you." Now that He is going away, what feeling filled their hearts?
questions.explanation: John 16:6 (ESV): "But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart."

questions.question: Jesus said it was to their advantage that He go away. Why?
options: For if he does not go away, the Helper will not come to them
So that Israel would be established as the eternal kingdom
So that the disciples could rule the twelve tribes
So that the temple would be cleansed permanently
questions.correctAnswer: For if he does not go away, the Helper will not come to them
questions.explanation: John 16:7 (ESV): "Nevertheless, I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you."

questions.question: When the Helper comes, He will convict the world concerning sin, righteousness, and what third thing?
questions.explanation: John 16:8 (ESV): "And when he comes, he will convict the world concerning sin and righteousness and judgment:"

questions.question: "When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth, for he will not speak on his own authority, but whatever he hears he will speak, and he will declare to you..."?
questions.explanation: John 16:13 (ESV): "When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth, for he will not speak on his own authority, but whatever he hears he will speak, and he will declare to you things that are to come."

questions.question: The disciples were confused about Jesus speaking of "a little while." Jesus used what metaphor to explain the coming sorrow turning to joy?
options: A woman in labor who forgets her anguish when the baby is born
A farmer who rests after the harvest is finished
A soldier returning home after a long war
A traveler finding shelter after a long road
questions.correctAnswer: A woman in labor who forgets her anguish when the baby is born
questions.explanation: John 16:21 (ESV): "When a woman is giving birth, she has sorrow because her hour has come, but when she has delivered the baby, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a human being has been born into the world."

questions.question: "So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will..."?
questions.explanation: John 16:22 (ESV): "So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again, and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you."

questions.question: "In that day you will ask nothing of me. Truly, truly, I say to you, whatever you ask of the Father in my name, he will..."?
questions.explanation: John 16:23 (ESV): "In that day you will ask nothing of me. Truly, truly, I say to you, whatever you ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you."

questions.question: Jesus plainly told them: "I came from the Father and have come into the world, and now I am leaving the world and going..."?
questions.explanation: John 16:28 (ESV): "I came from the Father and have come into the world, and now I am leaving the world and going to the Father."

questions.question: When the disciples said "now you are speaking plainly," Jesus responded by asking if they now believed. What did He say would happen to them?
options: "The hour is coming, indeed it has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and will leave me alone."
"You will all be arrested at dawn."
"You will be chased from the synagogues entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "The hour is coming, indeed it has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and will leave me alone."
questions.explanation: John 16:32 (ESV): "Behold, the hour is coming, indeed it has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and will leave me alone."

questions.question: Even when they scatter and leave Jesus alone, He says He is not truly alone. Why?
questions.explanation: John 16:32 (ESV): "Yet I am not alone, for the Father is with me."

questions.question: What is the great assurance at the end of John 16?
options: "In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world."
"The Spirit will give you power to conquer all."
"No weapon formed against you shall prosper."
"I will never leave you nor forsake you entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world."
questions.explanation: John 16:33 (ESV): "I have said these things to you, that in me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world."

questions.question: Concerning judgment, Jesus said the ruler of this world stands condemned. Why does the Spirit convict the world of righteousness?
options: "because I go to the Father, and you will see me no longer."
"because the Law commands pure obedience entirely."
"because the angels enforce the statutes of heaven."
questions.correctAnswer: "because I go to the Father, and you will see me no longer."
questions.explanation: John 16:10 (ESV): "concerning righteousness, because I go to the Father, and you will see me no longer;"

questions.question: Jesus said He had many more things to say but they could not bear them now. Who will guide them into all truth?
questions.explanation: John 16:12-13 (ESV): "I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now. When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth..."

questions.question: Jesus said the Spirit will glorify Him. How did He explain this?
options: "for he will take what is mine and declare it to you."
"for he will descend visibly upon you fully."
"for he will speak audibly from heaven loudly."
"for he will raise the dead in my name."
questions.correctAnswer: "for he will take what is mine and declare it to you."
questions.explanation: John 16:14 (ESV): "He will glorify me, for he will take what is mine and declare it to you."

key_verse_text: "In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world."
